notes.title: Hotfix Patch #3
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing!

Hey everyone, a new hotfix is live which fixes a variety of bugs and adjusts game balance. We hope you're enjoying your time playing Bloodless! 

Changes

 Adjusted the balance on the Bakushiki Tusk Crest by increasing its stamina cost

Fixes:

 Fixed playable screen area issues with 16:10 resolutions
 Fixed an issue where combat wouldn't initiate on Help Sharphead Mountains sidequest
 Fixed an issue where Tomoe would get stuck on a pushed animation loop after the Tea Gourd tutorial
 Fixed pause popup being triggered by the Steam Overlay activation
 Fixed Vibration toggle functionality on the options menu
 Fixed an issue during the Tokichiro boss fight  where he would not use his full moveset 


If you experience other bugs or issues, submit a ticket to our Support page or the Bloodless Discord server.

If you enjoyed the game, tell a friend and leave us a review! It helps a lot 🙏.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592490/Bloodless/

notes.title: Hotfix Patch #2
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing!
It's great to see the positive reviews on Steam and to hear from everyone enjoying Bloodless since launch!

We have just released another hotfix patch to address a few minor bugs. We've outlined the changes below:

Fixes:

 Fixed an issue where the Eikichi NPC was in front of Tomoe’s sprite on Sacred Path
 Fixed a bug where ‘red’ attacks from Heavy enemies could be countered like a normal ‘white’ attack
 Fixed an issue where Tomoe could leave the battle before it started and be blocked outside on Sharphead Mountains and Old City
 Fixed an issue where the Heavy enemy with chains on Sharphead Mountains had a blindspot where they couldn’t attack Tomoe
 Fixed incorrect UI button prompts of additional Tea Gourds tutorial

If you experience other bugs or issues, submit a ticket to our Support page or the Bloodless Discord server.

If you enjoyed the game, leave us a review! It helps a lot 🙏.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592490/Bloodless/

notes.title: Hotfix Patch #1
notes.notes:
Bloodless is finally out!
Thank you to everyone who has played Bloodless so far! Our whole team at Point N' Sheep is really proud of the game and we're excited to see players enjoying it!

We just pushed our first hotfix patch for the game and we've outlined the changes below:

Changes:

 Increased knockback strength from Fast Lieutenant’s larger Shuriken attack

Fixes:

 Fixed an issue where UI button prompts would overlap
 Fixed a resolution scaling issue on Steam Deck
 Improved Elite Soldier animation timings
 Fixed an issue where Sora and Kenji would disappear before leaving on the ‘Help Bandits’ sidequest
 Fixed a visual bug with bamboo poles in the Bamboo Forest

If you experience other bugs or issues, submit a ticket to our Support page or the Bloodless Discord server.

If you enjoyed the game, leave us a review! It helps a lot 🙏.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592490/Bloodless/
